Vulkan Anchor for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).

An unofficial modified build of VulkanMod Reforged, written with an AI coding assistant, to run legacy Forge modpacks on Vulkan. Experimental: compatibility and feature parity are incomplete. See README.md for the mods each tested modpack needs disabled.

Install only the production JAR, in place of VulkanMod or VulkanMod Reforged. The source JAR and source ZIP are for development. SHA256SUMS.txt lists download checksums.

The source ZIP contains the corresponding source and build scripts for this commit. LGPL-3.0-only; preserve applicable notices and identify modified versions. See LICENSE, COPYING, NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
